verdict.rationale: E2B documents its own lifecycle-event webhooks that send notifications to an external web server when certain sandbox lifecycle events occur. That is a native event-to-action trigger, but the only action is an outbound HTTP notification, and there is no evidence of user-defined rules or conditions. Missing for 10: a rule definition/condition engine, built-in actions beyond webhook delivery, event types beyond sandbox lifecycle, and detailed docs or independent corroboration of the webhook feature.
